title: Smoked Pork Belly Skillet
description: A hearty, flavorful skillet dish featuring tender smoked pork belly, perfect for a satisfying dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until caramelized (5-7 minutes).
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced apple and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the sliced smoked pork belly and stir to coat with the onion mixture.
In a small bowl, whisk together the brown sugar, Dijon mustard, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the glaze over the pork belly and continue to cook for 2-3 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the heat and garnish with chopped parsley (if using).
Serve the smoked pork belly skillet hot, sliced into thick strips.
